name: Body
overview: Scripture reveals the body as a sacred creation, fearfully and wonderfully made by God, deserving of respect and care (Psalms 139:14). It is described metaphorically as a house or temple, emphasizing its temporary and fragile nature, subject to corruption yet destined for resurrection (Job 4:19; Job 17:14). Believers are called to honor their bodies by avoiding sinful practices and instead offering themselves as instruments of righteousness to God (Romans 6:13). This understanding calls Christians to reject harmful alterations or markings on the body, recognizing life and the body as gifts from God that surpass mere physical needs (Leviticus 19:28; Matthew 6:25).
